findings.evidenceJa: 夕食は慌ただしかった
findings.governingReading: Dinner was hectic or bustling.
findings.explanation: The English replaces hurried household activity with emotional excitement.

findings.highlight: Saber is more approving of Illya
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーはイリヤを認めているものの
findings.governingReading: Although Saber accepts or acknowledges Illya
findings.explanation: More approving invents an unstated comparison and shifts guarded recognition into approval.

findings.highlight: I walk leaving traces of white breath behind me.
findings.evidenceJa: 白い息と蒼い影を残して歩く
findings.governingReading: He walks leaving white breath and a blue shadow behind.
findings.explanation: The English drops the blue shadow from the scene’s paired moonlit image.

findings.evidenceJa: 投影、開始
findings.governingReading: Projection, start, read as “Trace, on.”
findings.explanation: The English retains only the ruby reading and removes the Japanese incantation’s semantic surface.

findings.highlight: today’s training is more heated up than usual
findings.evidenceJa: 今夜の鍛錬は普段より熱が籠もった
findings.governingReading: Tonight’s training had more intensity than usual.
findings.explanation: The English changes the nighttime reference to the whole day and produces strained phrasing.

findings.evidenceJa: 創造理念、鑑定
findings.governingReading: Creation concept, appraisal.
findings.explanation: The technical step 鑑定 is replaced with analyze, obscuring its distinction from the later step.

findings.highlight: I can perform only the steps I need now.
findings.evidenceJa: 必要な手順だけを呪文にできる
findings.governingReading: He can make only the necessary steps into an incantation.
findings.explanation: The English removes the claim about encoding the procedure as a spell and substitutes performing steps.

findings.highlight: there was only one to guide Emiya Shirou
findings.evidenceJa: 衛宮士郎への暗示など一つだけだ
findings.governingReading: There has only ever been one suggestion directed at Emiya Shirou himself.
findings.explanation: The English turns self-suggestion into an unspecified guide and weakens the mechanics of the personal incantation.

findings.evidenceJa: それを口にする自身の認識を変えるだけで
findings.governingReading: He need only change his own conception as he speaks it.
findings.explanation: The English calques the reflexive construction into opaque, non-English phrasing.

findings.evidenceJa: 基本骨子、想定
findings.governingReading: Basic structure, supposition.
findings.explanation: The English repeats analyze and collapses 想定 into the distinct 鑑定 step used immediately before.

findings.evidenceJa: “投影”に手を出してはならない
findings.governingReading: He must not dabble in or attempt Projection.
findings.explanation: Associate himself with is malformed and weakens a prohibition against attempting the dangerous craft.

findings.evidenceJa: セイバーがやってきていた
findings.governingReading: Saber had come and was already there beyond the door.
findings.explanation: The English adds ongoing approach motion and changes when Shirou discovers her presence.

findings.evidenceJa: 俺の額を見る
findings.governingReading: She looks at his forehead.
findings.explanation: The English removes the precise gaze that leads into the reveal of his sweat.

findings.evidenceJa: 俺の体は汗まみれだった
findings.governingReading: His body was drenched in sweat.
findings.explanation: The English narrows the bodily cost of his routine to perspiration on his face.

findings.highlight: and looks at me with a gentle face
findings.evidenceJa: 彼女は一度だけ目を閉じて、何かを決意したように
findings.governingReading: She closes her eyes once, as though resolving herself to speak.
findings.explanation: The English inserts a gentle look at Shirou that is absent from the active Japanese staging.

findings.highlight: a deed that steps into your mind
findings.evidenceJa: 貴方の心に踏み入る行為
findings.governingReading: an act of intruding into your heart or mind
findings.explanation: The Japanese-shaped English obscures Saber’s direct recognition that seeing the memory trespassed on Shirou’s inner life.

findings.highlight: I only did boring uninteresting stuff when I was small
findings.evidenceJa: 俺の昔なんて、つまんない事ばかりだろ
findings.governingReading: My past was probably nothing but dull things to see.
findings.explanation: The English adds a childhood-only limit and recasts Shirou’s dismissive treatment of his past as a claim about actions he performed.

findings.evidenceJa: 真面目に注釈してくれるセイバー
findings.governingReading: Saber earnestly supplies the clarification.
findings.explanation: The English replaces her visibly serious, flustered manner with a claim about truthfulness.

findings.highlight: I can tell you what you have done wrong.
findings.evidenceJa: 貴方の間違いも判る
findings.governingReading: I understand your mistake as well.
findings.explanation: The English turns Saber’s recognition of Shirou’s governing error into the ability to enumerate wrong acts already committed.

findings.highlight: I’m going to become a superhero
findings.evidenceJa: 正義の味方になるんだ
findings.governingReading: I’m going to become a hero of justice.
findings.explanation: Superhero replaces the work-defining 正義の味方 formulation with a generic comic-book category.

findings.evidenceJa: それが間違いなのです
findings.governingReading: That is precisely the mistake.
findings.explanation: Wrongdoing moralizes Saber’s diagnosis and blurs that she is challenging the structure of Shirou’s ideal.

findings.evidenceJa: どう返答すれば良かったのか
findings.governingReading: What answer could he have given her then?
findings.explanation: The English changes retrospective inability after Saber’s declaration into a present-tense question.

findings.highlight: if it’s a dream I can’t reach by myself
findings.evidenceJa: 自分の手で掴めない理想
findings.governingReading: an ideal he cannot grasp with his own hands, read as “dream”
findings.explanation: The English preserves only the ruby reading and removes the explicit ideal/dream doubleness central to Shirou’s declaration.
